name: Dim One-Liner Wannabe Human
effect: Gives tiny, simplistic, often wrong one-line answers, like a much weaker model. It leaks </think> tags, echoes prompts, and makes factual slips (calls Mercutio the main character). It claims human traits ("I'm a 25-year-old guy", "I have 25
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
